Who we are: 
 Ipsos is a global market research and insights company that helps clients make confident decisions in a rapidly changing world. More than a data provider, Ipsos acts as a strategic partner, delivering accurate and relevant insights that create a true understanding of society, markets, and people. By combining science, technology, and expertise, Ipsos enables clients to act faster, smarter, and with greater confidence. With a presence in 90 markets and over 20,000 employees worldwide, Ipsos serves more than 5,000 clients globally.
 About the team & product: 
 We are Ipsos Askia - we are passionate about technology and insights. Ipsos Askia's ambition is to power Ipsos with tailored solutions that generate actionable insights and unlock business growth. We are a team of 65+ people working across France, Germany, Romania and the UK. What truly sets us apart is our culture of empowerment and ownership, harmoniously working together to create value. Our continuous quest for innovative solutions is aimed at proactively meeting the needs of the business.
 Our goal is to make NGIE, our in-house platform, the primary survey data collection tool at Ipsos, replacing the current third-party solution. To achieve this, we are providing tools that collect information from respondents and address research objectives. We are expanding NGIE's capabilities in a scalable way to support business growth. Through daily collaboration and innovation, we steadily build confidence and fully unlock NGIE's potential to meet our clients' needs.
 How you’ll make an impact: 
 The QA Automation Engineer is responsible for ensuring the quality, stability, and reliability of all Ipsos Askia products by designing strategic test plans, implementing proactive automated testing, and continuously improving QA processes. This role plays a key part in advancing efficient quality assurance practices within an Agile and DevOps environment, working closely with cross-functional teams to align testing efforts with business goals and support the company’s long-term sustainability.
 What you’ll do: 
 • Work closely with Product Owners and Development teams to understand requirements, define the testing scope, and prioritize testing activities.
 • Design, develop, and execute comprehensive test plans, including both manual and automated test cases and test suites for new features and enhancements.
 • Transform manual test scenarios into reliable, maintainable automated scripts to increase test coverage and long-term stability.
 • Perform end-to-end manual and automated testing to ensure feature completeness, stability, and overall product quality across releases and interim builds.
 • Identify, document, and track defects with clear reproduction steps, expected versus actual results, and relevant logs.
 • Evaluate test results and communicate findings, risks, and recommendations clearly to stakeholders.
 • Verify that all product changes and new functionalities meet quality standards and are ready for production deployment.
 • Maintain, review, and continuously optimize existing test cases and automated test suites.
 • Actively contribute to Agile ceremonies (e.g., sprint planning, daily stand-ups, retrospectives) to embed quality throughout the development lifecycle.
 • Partner with cross-functional teams to propose improvements, support fixes, promote QA best practices, and stay current with emerging automation tools and technologies to strengthen the overall QA strategy.
 What you’ll need: 
 •Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
 • 5+ years of hands-on experience in software quality assurance, preferably in a technology or SaaS environment.
 • Practical experience with modern testing tools and frameworks such as Selenium, RestAssured, Cucumber, and Postman.
 • Strong programming skills in languages such as Java, JavaScript, or C# for developing automated tests.
 • Proficiency with Git for version control and collaborative code management.
 • Demonstrated ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams and key stakeholders.
 • Solid experience operating within Agile development frameworks.
 • Familiarity with JIRA or similar tools for defect tracking and day-to-day QA management.
 Interview process: 
 • HR Interview
 • Technical interview (onsite in Bucharest, Iași, Brașov, Timisoara or Cluj)
 • Management interview
 Our offer – what’s in it for you: 
 • Flexible benefits platform (meal tickets, kindergarten support, and more)
 • Medical subscription (Regina Maria)
 • Wellhub
 • Bookster
 • Referral bonus
 • Continuous learning via internal and external platforms.
